final.title: IRS audit notice for 2016 tax return
steps: Review the enclosed forms: Form 886-H-EIC (for Earned Income Credit), Form 14950 (for Premium Tax Credit), and Form 886-H-HOH (for Head of Household Filing Status).

Gather copies of the requested supporting documents showing your child met the relationship, age, and residency tests, that you qualify for the Premium Tax Credit, and that you are the head of your household.
Complete the enclosed Response form and mail or fax it along with your supporting documentation within 30 days from January 28, 2019 (by February 27, 2019).
If you cannot get your documentation ready in time, call 866-xxx-xxxx.
final.objection: Review the enclosed Publication 3498-A (The Examination Process), which describes your appeal rights. No specific appeal deadline is stated in this notice.
final.if_ignored: If you do not mail or fax your supporting documentation within 30 days, the IRS will disallow the audited items, send you an audit report showing proposed changes to your tax return, and you may owe additional tax plus penalties and interest.

explained.title: IRS Tax Return Audit Notice CP75
steps: Review the enclosed forms and gather copies of information that support the audit items: Earned Income Credit, Premium Tax Credit, and Head of Household Filing Status.
Complete the Response form and mail or fax it to the IRS along with your documentation within 30 days from the date of the notice.
Call 866-xxx-xxxx if you cannot get your documentation ready in time.
explained.if_ignored: The IRS will disallow the items being audited, send you an audit report showing proposed changes to your tax return, and you may owe additional tax.

If you are filing a petition because you did not file a 2023 Ohio IT 1040 return, include the return with your petition unless an exception applies.

final.title: Motor vehicle registration renewal notice
steps: Check if your county (HAMILTON) requires emissions testing before renewing (required in Davidson, Hamilton, Rutherford, Sumner, Wilson, and Williamson Counties); visit tn.gov/revenue/renewals for testing locations.

Renew your registration by paying 29.00 (plus $2.00 if ordering a decal by mail, or an optional $1.00 for Organ Donor Awareness) online at tncountyclerk.com, through the app at getautoassistant.com, at a kiosk (see tncountyclerk.com for locations), by mail to HAMILTON COUNTY CLERK, PO BOX 24868, CHATTOOGA TN 37422 with your payment and renewal notice, or in person at your local county clerk office with your renewal notice or current registration.
final.if_ignored: The letter does not state what happens if you do not renew.

explained.title: Motor vehicle registration renewal notice
steps: Complete emissions testing prior to renewing if your vehicle is registered in Davidson, Hamilton, Rutherford, Sumner, Wilson, or Williamson County.

Pay the renewal fee of 29.00 online at tncountyclerk.com, via the app at getautoassistant.com, at a kiosk, in person, or by mail by sending payment and this notice to your local county clerk office at HAMILTON COUNTY CLERK, PO BOX 24868, CHATTOOGA TN 37422.
explained.if_ignored: The letter does not state what happens if you do not renew, but driving with an expired registration is illegal.

final.title: Request for 2023 tax supporting documents
steps: Send the following documents within 20 days: proof of the amounts claimed for childcare costs; an official certificate showing your 2023 tied individual pension contributions (OPP3A); and supporting documents for passive interest due in 2023 and debts as of December 31, 2023.

To submit the documents online, go to www.vd.ch/impots, select the service 'Déposer des pièces justificatives fiscales sur demande de l'autorité fiscale', and authenticate using your e-PJ control code X00000.
If you need more time, you can also request an extension on the same website.
Quote your taxpayer number 000.000.00 in any correspondence.
final.if_ignored: The letter does not state what happens if you do not respond.
corrected: read as "CODE DE CONTRÔLE e-PU", understood as "CODE DE CONTRÔLE e-PJ" (e-PJ control code for submitting supporting documents online).
read as "vous présensons", understood as "vous présentons" (we present to you).

explained.title: Request for tax documents from Vaud tax office
steps: Send the justification for the amounts claimed for childcare expenses within 20 days.
Send the official certificate for tied individual pension contributions (OPP3A) paid in 2023 within 20 days.
Send the supporting documents for passive interest due in 2023 and debts as of December 31, 2023, within 20 days.
Alternatively, you can upload these documents online at www.vd.ch/impots using your e-PJ control code X00000.
explained.if_ignored: The letter does not state what happens if you do not respond, but you may lose deductions or receive an estimated taxation.

final.title: Parking fee payment notice
steps: Pay the FPS amount due by March 5, 2018 using your telepayment number 0000000000 00 0 000 001 00.
To pay by smartphone or internet, scan the QR code or go to www.stationnement.gouv.fr and pay by bank card.
To pay by phone, call 0811 10 10 10 (0,05 €/min + normal call cost) and pay by bank card.
To pay in person, go to a public finance center (centre des finances publiques) and pay by bank card or cash (up to 300€).

To pay by mail, send a check in euros payable to Trésor public to 35908 RENNES CEDEX 09 (TSA 30806), enclosing the payment card (CARTE DE PAIEMENT) without stapling or gluing it, in a stamped return envelope with no other documents.
final.if_ignored: If you do not pay or pay an insufficient amount by 05/03/2018, an enforceable order (titre exécutoire) will be issued against you with a surcharge of 20% of the unpaid FPS amount, with a minimum surcharge of 50 euros.

explained.title: Parking fine payment notice (FPS)
steps: Pay using the telepayment number 0000000000 00 0 000 001 00 via smartphone at www.stationnement.gouv.fr, by calling 0811 10 10 10, or at a public finance center.
Alternatively, pay by mail by sending a check in euros made out to the Trésor public along with the payment card to the address mentioned on the card using the return envelope.
explained.if_ignored: An enforceable title with a 20% surcharge (at least 50 euros) will be issued against you.

final.title: Water and wastewater bill
steps: Pay 99,52 € by January 20, 2022 using one of the payment methods listed on the bill.

To pay by TIP SEPA: date and sign the payment slip, attach a RIB (bank account details) if requested or if your bank details changed, and mail it to Centre d'encaissement des Finances publiques - 35908 RENNES CEDEX 9 without using paperclips, staples, tape, or folding it.

To pay by check: attach the unsigned payment slip with a check payable to TRÉSOR PUBLIC and mail it to Centre d'encaissement des Finances publiques - 35908 RENNES CEDEX 9 without using paperclips, staples, tape, or folding it.
To pay in person: use the QR code to pay by bank card or cash at a tobacconist (buraliste) or an approved partner.
To pay online: visit https://www.eau-normandie.fr/facturation/paiements/ or log in to your subscriber account at https://eaux.meusegrandsud.fr/ with ID 00000 and password AAAA888.

steps: Pay $3,999.86 immediately, or by March 12, 2009, by check or money order made payable to the United States Treasury.

final.if_ignored: If you do not pay or call immediately by March 12, 2009, the IRS may seize any state tax refund you are entitled to and apply it to your debt. If a balance remains, they may seize your other property or rights to property.

final.title: Proposed IRS changes to 2006 tax return
steps: Review this notice and compare the IRS's proposed changes with your 2006 tax return.
If you agree with the changes, complete, sign, and date the Response Form on page 5 and mail it with your payment of $2,289.00 so the IRS receives it by July 16, 2008.

If you cannot pay the full amount, pay as much as you can now and send the Response Form along with an Installment Agreement Request (Form 9465(SP)), which you can download at www.irs.gov/espanol or request by calling 1-800-829-3676 (or 1-800-829-3676).
If you do not agree with the changes, complete the Response Form on page 5 and mail it with a signed statement and any supporting documents so the IRS receives it by July 16, 2008.
